title: About
headline: I learned the web by building it — from WordPress blogs to full-stack products.
paragraphs: I started with WordPress and blogging, ran five sites at once, and learned the hard way that focus beats multitasking. That detour gave me a deep grasp of on-page SEO, which led to my first internship in SEO and digital marketing.

From there I moved into development with the MERN stack. After graduating I qualified for GATE, and today I build client websites as a Lead Web Developer while going deep on backend engineering with Java.
